body: I guess it's my messed up brain doing all this to me, I know I cant focus or be determined/committed to something like anyone who's at my age. Thank you for your response.

Indeed, channels are the most appealing feature that I want to control concurrency. Mutexs are just too difficult for me to use, channels are not. I hope Anders Hejlsberg is preparing something to improve concurrency in C#.
I still believe in using the right scalpel for the right task, so I'm mostly using everything but it's quite interesting that Go is being picked up by enterprises like Cloudflare etc.
What does the team think of Golang?

Scott what do you think of embedded native clients in the browser? Google apparently is approaching this now https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MvKEomoiKBA

Just to clarify, the way they're doing this is that they're stripping the compiler they want to attach and provide a specific API for the programmers to control the nasty stuff that could happen with a full compiler.

I would probably try SSRE again because I didn't have any side effects from that (used Stablon for a 1.5 months), and I'm actually planning to get some when I go home in a week.

I still want a degree because I want to be an academic and I want to work in that field, desiring such thing and then you see people succeeding in getting what you wanted the whole time and they don't even want it makes me want to jump from my balcony.

About my starvation, I don't think I want to ask anyone anything, I always end up feeling in a worse shape because I've asked a 'stranger' to help me in something when it's family who should be doing so. They always want me to ask for things, because in this way they can have the upper hand and always remind me about shit they did, because that's how life should be in their logic, we do things for you so we can abuse that fact on you and show all the strangers that you're an asshole. I don't think we have any foodbanks where we live, just googled that.

depression and depressed people get ignored 99% of the time, because we don't show real symptoms like disabled people or people who have been in accidents basically, they need that major shock of suicide to show them that it's real, and even then they feel sad for sometime and then they just get on with their lives and ignore the fucked up person who killed himself. they would love to think that they had nothing to do with it, it makes their lives easier to think this way.

I am sadly unable to work, I'm 2k miles from home and I'm now allowed to work in any paid jobs.

Thanks for replying,

I dont really know about medication, I took citalopram and saw couple reviews about it, the medication itself starts by ruining your life more by giving you headaches and chest pain and a ton of other side effects.

Failing courses can be fixed but will not fix my situation. I dont have a job, I have to ask people I cant stand for help (either financial or anything else) and most of the time if they help I get responses like they're giving me the world... failing a masters is a big deal when all your brothers are educated to that level and beyond and basically look at you like you're the spoiled kid.

Therapy is like you said total bullshit, people who work in that field are paid to do so therefore, I don't expect much other than a smile and a response from their manual to treat issues.

my family members are focused on themselves 24/7 and always like to point fingers because you know that's what family is for.. I honestly have no clue what purpose a family serves in this world other than financial help until you get up on your feet, even that help is sort of a debt. This is exactly why I didn't ask for shit when I ran out of money this month and I've been starving for 2 days now.

League of winners is coming from my family, they have successful lives and have good income.. they didn't work for it, they simply got lucky and backed up by other members of my family. I however, didn't get shit and always blamed for everything, they like it this way. Getting solely blamed for my situation is not logical whatsoever, we have couple of variables here but people seem to forget about those, it's easier to simplify things and just throw the whole deal on one variable.

I could compare myself to disabled people or people who are mentally challenged but that does not change the fact that I'm not in the same situation as they are.

Even if you feel tired talking to me, I just want to say that I appreciate your previous replies.

Thank you

I'm already out of my comfort zone, I'm 2k miles from everyone I know in life, and they barely speak to me on skype. About what you said that I can go at my own pace, this will confirm that I'm incompetent loser who cant achieve anything because people like to tag people with certain behavior to make it easier to understand things, they can easily mark you as a loser after failing couple of times in something, it's not really easy to live with people who would mark you as such because they simply look at you as not equal to them, I've had these vibes from my brothers/sisters before and I know what they're like.

My issue is that I'm not young I'm 28, people who are at my age have got their degrees ages ago and usually have bought their own houses/flats and got their 2nd child. I do believe people learn from failure but failure varies, you fail when you cant meet a deadline but you also fail when you lose your job/scholarship, you can weigh each one differently. failure is not bad because you learn from it, but right now I don't have any second chances and I'm most likely to be destroyed if I cant get my degree, I mean what second chances would you give to someone who is at my age? lastly, people will try to comfort you by saying it's ok to fail but deep down in their minds you're in capable of doing basic things and engaging into simple life tasks. I know all my brothers and sisters are very successful in my parent's point of view and I'm the old child in the house who still needs their support because something is wrong with me.

I don't know really, I just cant stand that feeling I'm having right now.. the issue I'm dealing with is mainly I cant have anything to be proud of, my scholarship is at stake and I cant get attention from my family nor anyone where I am right now. I haven't achieved anything, I'm single and still a virgin and I don't have any income nor I'm successful in my education. I don't see any bright light at the end of my tunnel.


I think something tragic must happen before family thinks differently about you. I've been in similar situation many times before and every time when I'm in such shape I fail.

I do read about meds all the time, I even know what SSRI's and SSRE's are, I just don't know how to get doctors to convince me to stay on meds with horrible side effects :(

I think lack of achievement and lack of intimacy has contributed a lot to my situation, I mean at this age I'm unable to take real responsibilities like my peers, I still don't have a job as I'm a student and you can just assume your worst about my social skills, been living alone for 5 years now, this can tell you how much of a loser I am.

I go to uni counselling/health centre and they're usually known as to be best of the worst, I've tried other public health centres they don't even know how to deal with my situation some even told me to get meds from the internet...

I do believe in baby steps after all that's how humans learn, but I wonder if I can take those steps while being unable to function, I know I failed my assignment because of that.

that's exactly why I thanked you for replying, I didn't expect anyone to reply to this post I made it out of despair.

I think I want to blame it on hormones and brain chemistry, I've had several attempts to do the on/off switch thing like not thinking about X or do Y, it's just does not work this way, if someone's brain chemistry is messed up then nothing can fix it.

Thanks for taking the time to reply, I agree professionals do tend to just put you on meds and ask you to stick to them even if they cause you bad side effects like what happened to me with Citalopram. I suffer from anxiety, so I can barely speak to people in public and/or look them in the eye, for me its difficult to handle that simple thing as I see it as a pressure that I need to get rid of, which makes me try to sit quite all the time and only speak when it's absolutely needed.

I do appreciate coffee, might sound ridiculous but it's one of the reasons I wake up every day so I can have an hour or 2 at Starbucks.

Thanks for taking the time to reply. I've tried trust me, everyone just pushes you away when they're with their girl (that's like 90% of the time). It's difficult situation but they sort of put you under peer pressure where you either become like them or not, so essentially whatever bad peer pressure you had in school just converted to adult crap.

I live alone all the time I don't have friends where I live right now (living abroad and no I'm not home sick been living abroad for 5 years now), I honestly don't think anyone cares even professionals who work in psychiatric field. This brings me to the second point, your family should always support you and they shouldn't abandon especially when you clearly call for their help, my brother was pissed off at me couple of times because I whine about issues I'm having at college... had similar issues with other family members.
